aheadHint: You are up to date. You can get ahead on the next words to review.

empty.title: No difficult words yet
empty.body: A word you mistype, or type much more slowly than the others, lands here. It then comes back at growing intervals, until 3 successes in a row.

shuffled.title: Each word, once
shuffled.body: The words to review, in random order.

repeated.title: Build the habit
repeated.body: Each word several times in a row, to set the key sequence.

sentences.title: In context
sentences.body: Sentences from your library that contain these words.

noSentence: No sentence in the library contains these words. Try shuffled or repeated words.

settings.title: Review
settings.slowFactorHint: A word typed more slowly than this threshold, compared with the other words of the session, becomes a difficult word.
